decisions.reason: Its disappearance from the website after only a limited 2023 mention suggests weak market traction and only a modest public commitment, so even with some sunk development costs management would let it go.
Although it had its own launch page in 2023, its complete absence in 2024 points to disappointing uptake that no longer justifies further escalation despite its closeness to the core offer.

It remained prominently presented through 2024, is close to the established business, and supports the firm's announced push in efficient digital production, which makes management likely to continue backing it.

As a 2024 launch with a dedicated page, it carries fresh investment and visible managerial commitment, so management would likely give this more distant diversification move more time and attribute any early weakness to a temporary market-development phase.
This 2024 product fits the firm's core digital manufacturing direction, and because it is still new management would be inclined to persist and try to build adoption rather than withdraw quickly.
